summary: Develop payment fraud monitoring, investigation and control skills for wallets, agents and merchants. Explore the course and build practical case tools.
lede: Digital payment fraud training helps fraud analysts, payment operations managers and risk teams investigate suspicious activity and document cases. Participants practise measuring payment risk, designing and tuning alert scenarios, tracing account links, reviewing agent and merchant controls, and preserving evidence for escalation. Exercises use Excel-based payment records and reference materials such as PCI DSS and FATF typologies; institution-specific system configuration is outside the course scope.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, investigate, test or oversee fraud risks in mobile money, digital wallets, agent networks, merchant acquiring and electronic payment operations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking, fintech or payment operations is recommended. Prior fraud investigation experience is useful but not required. No coding or programming is required; exercises use payment scenarios and spreadsheet-based analysis.
